Treasurer
Treasurer
The Neosho County Treasurer's office stops accepting title work at 3:30 pm each day.
The County Treasurer's Office is responsible for:
Processing all motor vehicle registrations.
Accepting and processing payment of real estate and personal property taxes.
Distributing monies to all the taxing entities at the County and State level.
Investing of Idle funds.
The County Treasurer is an agent for the State of Kansas for motor vehicle titles and tags. Neosho County does not provide a driver's license service because there is a Kansas Highway Patrol station in our county in Chanute.
Real Estate and Personal Property Taxes
The first half of the Real Estate and Personal Property taxes are due by December 20 of each year. If you opt to pay taxes in two halves, the second half is due by May 10 of each year. Your statement will have two detachable stubs at the bottom, one for the first half payment and one for the second half payment. No second-half statements are sent. CLICK HERE to view Property Tax information.
Online Property Tax Payments
Online property tax payments are now available. You will need your tax statement to complete this process. .
Motor Vehicle Online Services
Motor Vehicle Registration Renewal
Most tags can be renewed online with a credit card or E-Check by visiting the iKan.ks.gov website. The vehicle must be currently registered in Kansas, you must have a Kansas Motor Vehicle Registration Notice that contains a Personal Identification Number (PIN), a current address on the renewal notice, and most important the vehicle is currently insured by a participating insurance company. There is a convenience fee for the use of this service.
Reprint Registration Renewal Form(s)
Reprint Registration Renewal Form(s) (sent from the State of Kansas)
Motor Vehicle Forms
To download motor vehicle forms please visit the Kansas Department of Revenue website . These forms are Adobe Acrobat format and require Acrobat Reader 3.0 or above to open.
Note from Gabby Sands
We would like to remind you that you can renew your vehicles online at iKan.ks.gov . There will be additional information necessary to do so. Please visit the Kansas Department of Revenue website to read what you may need or call the office at 620-244-3800. We do not process driver's licenses at the Treasurer's Office, there is a driver's license office located in Chanute. We are working diligently to process mail and online registration renewals the same day that they are received.
You may also renew your vehicle registration by mail, please include a copy of your current insurance card.
You may pay real estate and personal property taxes, with check, cashier's check, or money order, by mail. If you have delinquent real estate taxes or personal property, please contact us for the total amount due. The due dates for Real Estate and Personal Property tax payments are set by state statute.
Our mailing address is:
P.O. Box 176
Erie, KS 66733
Thank You,
Gabby Sands, Neosho County Treasurer
